Lockheed Martin develops space-based technologies and security solutions to support innovation and mission success. The Software Engineer will perform sustainment and new development for the GVS suite of services within an Agile Scrum team, implementing features, maintaining integrations, and supporting GEOINT visualization using technologies such as JavaScript, Linux, and data pipelines.

Responsibilities
Plans, conducts, and coordinates software development activities
Designs, develops, documents, tests, and debugs software that contains logical and mathematical solutions to business/mission problems or questions in computer language for solutions by means of data processing equipment
Applies the appropriate standards, processes, procedures, and tools throughout the development life cycle
Applies knowledge of computer hardware and software, subject matter to be programmed in business/mission applications, information processing techniques used, and information gathered from system users to develop software
Corrects program errors, prepares operating instructions, compiles documentation of program development, and analyzes system capabilities to resolve questions of program intent, output requirements, input data acquisition, programming techniques, and controls
Ensures software standards are met
Perform sustainment and new development activities for the GVS suite of services, working within an Agile Scrum team to implement features, maintain integrations, and support on-demand GEOINT visualization
Work may involve development in JavaScript or other acceptable languages, Linux command line tasks, data pipeline support, and simple bug fixes or feature updates under close mentorship

Required
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or STEM field + 2 years experience; Associate's degree + 4 years, Master's + 0 years; or 6 years of professional software development experience in lieu of a degree
1 to 2 years of software development experience with one or more: JavaScript preferred; also acceptable: Java and TypeScript
Practical experience with at least one of: Red Hat Linux, PostgreSQL, AWS, or Apache HTTP Server
Exposure to Docker/Kubernetes container concepts
Strong analytical problem-solving skills and a willingness to participate in agile/scrum ceremonies
TS clearance required and active at start, with the ability to obtain TS/SCI with CI Poly per program timeline
Preferred
JavaScript preferred
Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, Git version control, and Agile/Scrum participation
Familiarity with OGC terminology (WMS, WFS, Tile Services) and geospatial data workflows
Basic exposure to AngularJS or other modern frontend frameworks, including migration concepts
Shell scripting or automation experience on Linux/UNIX using JavaScript, Python, or Java tools
Understanding of web services/APIs and basic debugging in a Linux environment
